decisions.reason: As an adjacent service backed by a dedicated business unit and linked to offshore renewables as well as oil and gas, it still offers strategic option value and reuse of core ship-management capabilities.
Crew and corporate travel management is complementary to the firm's maritime operations, and the pandemic likely made results noisy rather than conclusive enough to justify abandonment.
An online vessel information portal is a low-cost digital complement to the core business, so keeping it open preserves upside while uncertainty about client adoption continues to resolve.

A standalone mobile vessel performance app is the most likely to have shown by now whether adoption is strong enough, and if it has not it is a relatively easy option to discontinue or fold into other services.
